verdict.rationale: The docs say skills follow the Agent Skills open standard, which "works across multiple AI tools" and was published for cross-platform portability. The spec defines a portable SKILL.md folder format that other agents could consume. However, every documented install path is Claude-specific (Claude Code plugin marketplace, Claude API, Claude.ai), and one developer had to build their own model-agnostic adaptation to use the skills elsewhere. Missing for 10: install instructions for Codex, Cursor or other harnesses, any per-harness setup guidance, and hands-on evidence of the same collection working across multiple coding agents.
